group.div:
Connect ONVO in three steps
You need one secret API key and one webhook signing secret. No public key is needed. Start with test credentials from your ONVO account.
Get your secret API key from the ONVO Dashboard. Use onvo_test_secret_key_... for testing.
In ONVO, select the same test or live mode as your API key. Open Developers → Webhooks → Add webhook. Copy the URL below and select checkout_session.succeeded.
The URL must use your public HTTPS domain on port 443. If it shows localhost, HTTP or the wrong domain, correct your Odoo website/base URL first. Save a new provider before copying its URL.

Paste the signing secret shown when ONVO creates the endpoint. To find it again, open the endpoint and choose Reveal signing secret. Use the signed webhook format; the previous X-Webhook-Secret format is not supported.
With your permission, Odoo sends the amount, currency, transaction reference, buyer email, integration identifier and optional referral code to ONVO. Buyers enter card details on ONVO.

Leave Live off at the top of this form and keep the provider active. Save both secrets and the consent checkbox together. Then use Test connection on the webhook in ONVO and confirm a successful response. Publish the provider when ready to try checkout, complete a test payment in USD or CRC, and check that its Odoo transaction reaches Done.

Before going live, replace the test API key with onvo_live_secret_key_..., create a live-mode webhook and paste its signing secret. Change Odoo to live mode and save these changes together, then test the live webhook connection.

field.name: onvo_referral_code
field.placeholder: Only if ONVO gave you a partner code

group.div: Leave blank if you do not have an ONVO-issued code. The connector identifies itself to ONVO automatically. Referral credit depends on your agreement with ONVO.

page.name: onvo_apple_pay
page.div: Apple Pay works on your ONVO payment page. Use your existing ONVO credentials and webhook. No extra key, plugin or Odoo domain registration is needed for hosted checkout.

div.p: Open Settings → Payment methods in ONVO. Select test mode, enable card payments, then enable Apple Pay.
Your ONVO account must be activated. Review the merchant terms when prompted and wait for ONVO's Apple registration status to finish.
Leave Live off at the top of this form and keep the provider active. Save your settings, then create a test link below. Open it on an Apple device with a card in Wallet and choose Apple Pay.
You can copy the link to your own iPhone, iPad or Mac. After paying, use Check payment result in the test window and look for Done.
Apple Pay is enabled separately in ONVO's live mode. Enable it there when ready, then update Odoo with your live API key and live webhook signing secret and switch the provider to live mode.
Confirm the live webhook connection and payment flow before accepting customer orders. The test-link tool only creates sandbox checkouts.

ul.li: Look on the ONVO payment page after leaving Odoo.
Use a compatible Apple device with a supported card in Wallet. Try Safari or Chrome on that device.
Check that ONVO's account activation and Apple registration are complete, and both card payments and Apple Pay are on in the matching mode.
Test in USD or CRC with an eligible Costa Rica account. ONVO's test mode uses the real Wallet flow with simulated charges.

div.p: Activation status is shown in ONVO's Dashboard. A completed checkout in Odoo confirms payment; it does not by itself identify the wallet selected.
